title: dev-next: a run that stops keeps its claim, and an owner-merges story stops at its pull request
summary: A dev-next run that gives up now keeps its assignee (technical failures stay agent-ready, real questions go needs-human), a Resuming rule lets /dev-next #<N> pick a stopped story back up safely, and an owner-merges story stops at a green pull request. Version 24.

deferred.what: The baseline's Who merges rule says a person merges any pull request touching docs/PRDs/, docs/ADRs/, docs/ux/prototypes/ or the project's CLAUDE.md, but /dev-next still squash-merges its own story when its diff touches one of them, so a /dev-quick edit to CLAUDE.md lands with no person
deferred.why: Issue #173 covered only owner-merges; no open story on the 2026-11-03 epic carries dev-next's part of decision #161; the owner-merges stop is the natural mechanism
